turns.replyTail:
f your recipient needs to make a return, it must be initiated within 7 days of receiving the item by calling our team at 1-844-MY-STUGA (697-8842) to get a Return Authorization Number (RA#).
Please note that returned items must be unopened and unused, freight return shipping costs apply, and a restocking fee will be deducted ($500 for orders under $1,000, or 50% for orders over $1,000). Also, custom orders, samples, and accessories are non-returnable.
